annotations.title: Check website uptime and changes since last check

description: Checks web pages for uptime and for changes since the last check. Per URL: up/down/blocked status, HTTP status, response time, TTFB, redirect chain, DNS result and TLS days-to-expiry; for pages checked before, a change verdict (baseline | no-change | changed) with a plain-English summary and a unified diffExcerpt. Detects text changes in the whole page or a CSS/XPath region, price changes, list items added/removed, keywords appearing/disappearing, SEO-critical changes (title, meta description, canonical, H1, noindex appearing), robots.txt/sitemap changes and, in browser mode, screenshot pixel differences. The FIRST call for a URL returns changeStatus "baseline": reuse the same stateStoreName on later calls to compare. Saves a private snapshot in the caller's Apify storage (nothing on the target site changes). Dates, times, UUIDs and copyright years are ignored by default; add ignorePatterns/excludeSelectors for false changes. Respects robots.txt; blocked pages are not charged. Browser mode costs 3x an HTTP check. Runs an Apify Actor on the caller's own Apify account (billed by Apify pay-per-event, capped per run).

contentSelector.description: CSS selector of the region to compare

contentXPath.description: XPath of the region to compare

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to ignore when comparing (e.g. ads, timestamps, carousels).

keywordAlertOn.description: Alert when watched keywords appear, disappear, or both.

keywords.description: Words or phrases to watch; reported when they appear or disappear.

minChangePercent.description: Ignore text changes smaller than this percentage of the content.

mode.description: "http" is fast and cheap; "browser" renders JavaScript and enables visual diffs (costs 3x).

monitors.description: Optional per-URL settings that override the global ones.

resetBaseline.description: Discard the saved snapshot and start a new baseline.

seoChecks.description: Flag SEO-critical changes: title, meta description, canonical, H1, noindex.

stateStoreName.description: Your snapshot namespace (e.g. a project name); reuse it to compare with earlier calls.

trackPrices.description: Detect and compare prices on the page.

visualDiff.description: Compare screenshots pixel by pixel (browser mode only).

visualThresholdPercent.description: Minimum percentage of changed pixels that counts as a visual change.
